title: 4521-ESP-AGE-57-70-0007 R2
summary:
- This document is an instrument specification for the Solana project.
- It includes definitions for Supplier, Customer, Fabricator, and Owner.
- The scope of work involves supplying instruments and related materials.
- Heat Transfer Fluid (HTF) services are included in the specifications.
- Confidential information must not be disclosed without permission.
- RFQ No. 120006, Spec No. 4521-ESP-AGE-57-70-0007 for Solana project.
- All materials must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards; non-compliant materials will be returned and replaced at Supplier's expense.
- Vendor data required within specified weeks after order; quotation must include time for approval drawings and fabrication.
- Equipment to be delivered to purchaser's manufacturing site with specific locations; strict delivery schedule by December 2011.
- Recommended spare parts list with prices and delivery times.
- Equipment subject to inspection before shipment; Abener Teyma reserves the right to perform inspections during fabrication and prior to shipment.
- Invite recommendations for price, delivery or performance improvements; alternate quotations must specify alternate and prices/delivery times.
